summary: CVE-2024-38796 affecting package edk2 for versions less than 20240524git3e722403cd16-8
details: EDK2 contains a vulnerability in the PeCoffLoaderRelocateImage(). An Attacker may cause memory corruption due to an overflow via an adjacent network. A successful exploit of this vulnerability may lead to a loss of Confidentiality, Integrity, and/or Availability.
